name: logs
description: Agent-friendly log + telemetry sink. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (logs-serve) + SDK. Clients resolve their API key and URL through the @hasna/contracts client chain (Keychain item hasna.credentials.logs.api-key, ~/.hasna/logs/config/credentials, HASNA_LOGS_API_KEY; authority HASNA_LOGS_API_URL else the fleet gateway https://api.hasna.com/logs) and fail closed with no credential: the local SQLite store is reachable only via the explicit HASNA_LOGS_LOCAL=1 opt-in. The serve reads/writes the operator-owned Postgres directly with HASNA_LOGS_DATABASE_URL (API-key auth via @hasna/contracts), or the on-box SQLite collector under HASNA_LOGS_LOCAL=1. This is the shared S3-backed log sink other apps route to.

serviceSurfaces.name: logs-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The generated SDK ships, but the service contract requires a supported service SDK to declare an exportSubpath that exists in package.json exports with a generatedFrom pointing at the served OpenAPI document; logs exports only '.', './storage', and './api', and no ./sdk export exists yet.
